dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, you keep looking at your phone. Is everything OK?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, juː ˈkiːp ˈlʊkɪŋ ət jʊr ˈfoʊn. ɪz ˈɛvriθɪŋ oʊˈkeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. I'm reading about laptops. My old laptop keeps turning off.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. aɪm ˈriːdɪŋ əˈbaʊt ˈlæptɑːps. maɪ ˈoʊld ˈlæptɑːp ˈkiːps ˈtɜːrnɪŋ ˈɔːf.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Do you use your smartphone for homework?
dialogue.reading: duː juː ˈjuːz jʊr ˈsmɑːrtfoʊn fər ˈhoʊmwɜːrk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sometimes, but I don't enjoy typing on a small screen.
dialogue.reading: ˈsʌmtaɪmz, bʌt aɪ ˈdoʊnt ɪnˈdʒɔɪ ˈtaɪpɪŋ ɑːn ə ˈsmɔːl ˈskriːn.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: What about a tablet? I enjoy reading on my tablet.
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ə ˈtæblət? aɪ ɪnˈdʒɔɪ ˈriːdɪŋ ɑːn maɪ ˈtæblət.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Tablets are nice, but I want a real computer.
dialogue.reading: ˈtæbləts ər ˈnaɪs, bʌt aɪ ˈwɑːnt ə ˈriːəl kəmˈpjuːtər.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Do you mind spending a lot of money?
dialogue.reading: duː juː ˈmaɪnd ˈspɛndɪŋ ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈmʌni?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, I do! I'm trying to avoid spending more than twenty thousand baht.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈduː! aɪm ˈtraɪɪŋ tə əˈvɔɪd ˈspɛndɪŋ ˈmɔːr ðən ˈtwɛnti ˈθaʊzənd ˈbɑːt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK. When I finish studying today, let's go to the mall. I enjoy trying new devices!
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. wɛn aɪ ˈfɪnɪʃ ˈstʌdiɪŋ təˈdeɪ, ˈlɛts ˈɡoʊ tə ðə ˈmɔːl. aɪ ɪnˈdʒɔɪ ˈtraɪɪŋ ˈnuː dɪˈvaɪsɪz!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great! I need new headphones, too.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! aɪ ˈniːd ˈnuː ˈhɛdfoʊnz, ˈtuː.
